title: v12-action repository configuration (.github/v12-audit.yml)
description: Repository-level defaults for the v12-action GitHub Action. Action inputs set in the workflow override values from this file.

defaults.description: Default values for action inputs. A non-empty action input wins over the value here.

fail-on.description: Fail the job when a finding at this severity or above survives filtering. `none` never fails the job.

include-validity.description: Validity states that count as findings. Anything else is dropped before gating and reporting.

ignore-auto-invalidated.description: Drop findings that V12's own triage rejected (autoInvalidated) while they are still unreviewed. A reviewer's explicit validity always wins over the machine verdict.

max-cost-cents.description: Abort before creating a run when the V12 estimate exceeds this many US cents.

min-severity.description: Lowest severity shown on any surface. `qa` findings are hidden unless this is set to `qa`.

hide-comment-when-clean.description: Do not leave a pull request comment when no findings survive filtering (an existing comment is removed).

wait.description: Wait for the run to reach a terminal state. When false the job ends as soon as the run is created.

wait-timeout-minutes.description: How long to wait for the run before giving up. The run keeps going on V12's side; the job exits 0.

skip-if-unchanged.description: Skip diff reviews whose range contains no changes (after path filters).

fail-on-error.description: Fail the job when the V12 run ends failed or cancelled, or when waiting times out.

comment.description: Post or update the sticky pull request comment.

max-comment-findings.description: Maximum findings rendered with full details in the pull request comment.

check-run.description: Create the check run with inline annotations.

max-annotations.description: Maximum inline annotations posted on the check run (GitHub accepts 50 per request; the action batches).

upload-sarif.description: Upload the SARIF file to code scanning from within the action (needs security-events: write).

sarif-category.description: Code scanning category for the SARIF upload. Defaults to v12-audit/<mode>.

fetch-report.description: Download the run's Markdown report and expose it as the report-path output.

max-findings-detail.description: When V12's findings list is summary-only, fetch full details for at most this many findings (most severe first).

include.description: Paths or globs to audit. Directory prefixes (`contracts/`, `contracts/**`) are sent to V12 and reduce cost; other globs are expanded against the tree (at most 500 entries).

exclude.description: Globs whose findings are hidden. Exclusions are applied by the action, not by V12, so they do not reduce cost.

context-documents.description: V12 context document UIDs (UUIDs, see `v12 context list`) attached to every run. At most 100.

suppressions.description: Findings to hide from gating and the main tables. Every suppression expires; expired ones re-surface the finding with a warning.

fingerprint.description: The 16-character hex fingerprint printed in the finding's details in the pull request comment and job summary.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted or mitigated. Shown in the suppressed section of the comment.

expires.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, quote it in YAML) after which the suppression stops applying.

approved-by.description: Who approved the suppression, for the audit trail.

notify-on.description: When to send a Slack message.

mention-on-critical.description: Slack mention inserted when a critical finding is present, e.g. `<@U0123>` or `<!subteam^S0123>`.

thread.description: Reply in the thread of the previous message for the same pull request instead of posting a new top-level message (bot token only).

include-snippets.description: Include finding descriptions and code snippets in Slack. Off by default: Slack retention is not the security team's call. Findings are linked instead.

channel.description: Channel ID or name for bot-token delivery.

max-findings.description: How many findings to list in the message.
